decisions.reason: Although door lever handles fit our core engineering and manufacturing knowledge well, the product disappeared from the website after launch, suggesting weak enough market traction or differentiation that we would reallocate resources to stronger handle families.

The mitred door lever handle family remains visible in 2024 and builds directly on our existing architectural hardware, design and production capabilities, so we can keep learning from the market and refine it efficiently.

A multifunctional door lever handle closely matches our expertise in accessibility, safety and integrated hardware systems, and its own product page in 2024 signals enough strategic relevance to continue commercial development.
This door lever handle stays present in 2024 and lies squarely within our accumulated know-how in certified architectural hardware, making it a low-risk product to sustain and improve.

The door and window handle collection has dedicated ongoing promotion and award recognition, and it strongly leverages our design, planning-support and manufacturing knowledge, so it should remain in the portfolio.

Even though surface finishes are related to our proprietary finishing capabilities, the bronze finish is no longer highlighted in 2024, indicating limited commercial pull as a standalone offer relative to other development priorities.
